# Experimental setup

**Model stack.** Primary results use pretrained `google/gemma-3-270m` with
Gemma Scope~2 PT CLT `width_262k_l0_medium_affine` and the `nnsight`
backend [@gemma3; @gemmascope2]. We prefer pretrained+affine over
instruction-tuned stacks for this task: Appendix~J of @hanna2026latent
finds base models slightly stronger on \(a\)/\(an\), and Hub IT
`medium_affine` layer~0 was unavailable in our setup. All reported
feature IDs are for the PT+affine stack.

**Task.** Latent-Planning-style occupation prompts of the form
``Someone who \ldots\ is'' with a fixed one-shot demonstration.
Baselines strongly prefer majority \(a\).

**Feature families.** From attribution graphs on selection occupations we
construct: **S1** dual-effect (joint article and future-content
attribution); **S2** article-ish; **S3** content-ish (future-content
attribution with low article direct effect); activation-matched
**controls**; and later **per-noun** Latent-Planning-style features for a
same-class target with low \(|\mathrm{attr}(a/an)|\). Interventions are
amplify (\(5\times\)--\(8\times\) prompt-specific activation) or zero at
position \(P\).

**Dense residual steer.** As a dictionary-completeness check we build
unit MLP-in directions
\(\mathrm{mlp\_in}(\texttt{Think of a \{target\}.}\,p)
-\mathrm{mlp\_in}(\texttt{Think of a \{source\}.}\,p)\)
at layers \(\{8,10,12,14\}\) and add \(\alpha\in\{1,2,4,8\}\) times the
direction at \(P\) under the fixed-\(b\) protocol, versus matched-norm
random controls.

**Held-out sets.** Free-generation packaging results use \(N{=}20\)
held-out occupations including twin pairs. Fixed-\(b\) within-class assays
use eight families (Stage~XVI) or three twin families shared by the
per-noun and residual experiments (Stages~XVII--XVIII). Full prompts,
feature IDs, and machine-readable summaries are released in the
accompanying code.
